correctness.rationale: Every map is normalized by explicit comparable-map moves. Comparable arbitrary maps have a common level-preserving normalization, so the two stated local moves generate exactly the finite-space homotopy relation on normalized maps. These moves are fixed-length spur replacements. A two-move slide transports a redundant pair along the alternating walk, proving that with slack the component is determined exactly by the cyclically reduced core up to rotation; without slack the map is isolated. Burnside counting then gives the formula. Exhaustive finite map-poset checks agree on six representative tuples.
